name: Find My Brand
intro: Find My Brand is a free discovery tool. Paste a business website, and SmartVideo shows the logo, photos and branding it finds on the page.

features.find-my-brand-button: The big Find My Brand button opens the discovery window. It also opens by itself the first time you land here, and you can reopen it anytime.
features.website-url-discovery: Paste your website into the field and click Find My Brand. The button reads Finding while it works, and the assets it discovers appear for you to review.
features.search-for-a-business-instead: No website handy? Search for the business by name instead, then use its website for discovery. It's useful when you only know the name and place.
features.review-and-arrange: Review and arrange is where you tidy up. Drag discovered images into sections, open the viewer, and remove anything you don't want to keep.

outro: Start with a home page, review what turns up, and you'll have a clear picture of any brand.
